name: Couch Stretch
aliases: Rear Foot Elevated Hip Flexor Stretch
instructions: Kneel facing away from a couch, bench, or wall.
Place one shin vertically against the surface with the top of that foot pressed against it.
Step the other foot forward into a lunge, flat on the floor.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg to protect your lower back.
Gently push your hips forward to deepen the stretch through the hip flexor and quad of the kneeling leg.
Hold for the desired time, then switch sides.
